control or remote start if vehicle is in an enclosed area (e.g., closed garage) or a partially enclosed area without
ventilation. Close all doors leading from adjacent living areas to the vehicle area before executing a remote
climate control or remote start command. 11. 911 Connect must be enabled on headunit, and activates after
air bag deployment. Requires cellular coverage. UVO eServices requires a compatible smartphone connected via
Bluetooth® wireless technology; cellular service rates apply. 12. 24-hour Roadside Assistance is a service plan

wireless technology; cellular service rates apply. 13. Vehicle Diagnostics are not a substitute for regularly
scheduled maintenance. Vehicle Diagnostics checks powertrain, chassis, and airbag systems, and requires
initial activation. See the UVO Maintenance section or Owner’s Manual for maintenance schedule. 14. My
Car Zone requires cellular coverage and cellular service rates apply. For UVO eServices information must
be manually synced in order to receive alerts, and cellular service rates apply. 15. The estimated range is
based on a number of factors and assumes optimal driving conditions, efficient driving habits, and a straight
road. Actual range will vary with options, driving conditions, driving habits, vehicle maintenance, charging
practice, battery age, weather, temperature, and your vehicle’s condition. Battery capacity will decrease
with time and use. 16. Government 5-Star Safety Ratings are part of the National Highway Traffic Safety

driving conditions, and/or injury. Actual mileage may vary with driving conditions, driving habits, and your
vehicle’s condition. 18. Warranties include 10-year/100,000-mile powertrain and 5-year/60,000-mile basic.
All warranties and roadside assistance are limited. See retailer for warranty details.
